description: Confirm-gated suspend POST, the instance_id rejections and the dry-run preview. Both languages agree on a missing and a zero instance_id, so both are pinned. Neither refuses a numeric string: the message declares instance_id with no argument_reader, so "123" coerces and the call goes through in Go and Python alike, which is why no non-integer case appears here. The dry-run state body leaves engine version and replication type blank: TechDocs documents neither for Valkey.

cases.name: rejects missing instance_id
cases.expect_error: instance_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects zero instance_id
cases.expect_error: instance_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This suspends a Valkey Managed Database instance. Set confirm=true to proceed.

side_effects: Valkey Managed Database instance 123 will be suspended.
warnings: Suspending a Managed Database can interrupt service.
